thread:
maya: incident-bot just paged me for high GPU queue depth in us-west-2, several pools hitting 100% utilization. queues growing and requests getting 429s. I’m on it.
incident-bot: [INCIDENT"](/auto-create: GPU_CAPACITY_EXHAUSTION detected — affected service: inference-runtime/us-west-2, severity: P1. Paging rotation.
jamal: saw it, getting logs now. Prometheus metrics for hpa_custom_metrics_adapter show large scrape lag.
sophie: adding context — we merged a metrics-adapter change yesterday that bumped export latency, wondering if that regressed.
carlos: I’m on infra, checking node autoscaler/ HPA behaviour. Could be that the adapter stopped reporting pod custom metrics so HPA didn’t scale.
maya: customers reporting increased latencies and some timeouts. @pagerduty can you surface which customers are seeing 5xx?
pagerduty: High impact: 3 customers with heavy burst traffic — app-spark, noteflow, chatly. Alerts show increased error rates and queue retry spikes.
jamal: pulling metrics: prometheus shows `kube_hpa_status_last_modified_time_seconds` hasn't updated for inference-deployments for ~12m. adapter logs show `503 upstream` and `write tcp: connection reset by peer`.
sophie: past deploy note: we changed the adapter replica count to 2 from 3 to optimize cost last week. Might be underprovisioned for scrape spikes.
carlos: autoscaler logs indicate HPA fallback proceeded to safe default, but it requires custom metrics to scale beyond base. Without custom metrics, pods stayed at min_replicas=4. That explains the queue backlog.
maya: ok live mitigation plan: 1) scale metrics-adapter to 5, 2) restart adapter pods, 3) temporarily bump HPA min_replicas for affected deployments to 12, 4) enable permissive fallback to CPU-based scale for next 30m. Thoughts?
jamal: +1. I can run the scale and restarts. Command: ```kubectl scale deployment metrics-adapter -n infra --replicas=5```
sophie: also patch to adaptor config to increase `read_timeout` and `max_inflight_requests` while we investigate. sending patch now.
carlos: I’m going to raise node autoscaler limit for the GPU pool until we have queue down. `gcloud compute instance-groups managed resize gpu-pool-us-west2 --size=30` — will do if quotas allow.
maya: ensure we annotate this as temporary. Also notify Sales/Support for customer comms.
pagerduty: paging rotation updated — oncall handoff scheduled in 22 minutes. If this persists past handoff, do a warm handoff to next oncall with full notes.
jamal: scaled metrics-adapter to 5, rolling restart started, pods coming up. adapter logs now show `Started serving on :8080`.
sophie: applied short-lived config tweak and restarted, no errors in recent logs. Prometheus scrape backlog clearing slowly.
carlos: autoscaler resize initiated, cloud quota check passed, launching 6 more GPU nodes. Should be ready in ~5m.
maya: bumping HPA min_replicas on `inference-fast` and `inference-batch` to 12 now: ```kubectl patch hpa inference-fast -n inference --type='json' -p='[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/minReplicas","value":12}]'```
jamal: HPA patch applied. Watching queue depth metric: `inference_request_queue_length` peaked at 1450, now trending down to 400.
sophie: confirm: Prom adapter metrics are stable, `custom_metric_push_latency_seconds` < 200ms. HPA is now consuming metrics and started new replicas.
maya: customer impact update: partial degradation for heavy customers; chatly saw 20% request failures during peak, but now recovery in progress. Support notified with mitigation steps.
pagerduty: oncall handover note for next shift: remediation actions performed: scaled adapter, increased HPA minReplicas, resized GPU pool, config patch applied. Monitor until queue <50 for 15m.
jamal: small snag — one newly started GPU node failed healthcheck due to docker image pull rate limit, replaced that node manually. Might cause small delay.
carlos: replaced node, node pool back to expected count. No further pull rate failures in node logs. Recommend we add image pull-sidecar caching for next sprint.
sophie: logging a rollback for the adapter config change in case we see any regressions once traffic normalizes. Will open PR to revert after 2h.
maya: planning: 1) post-mortem with timeline, 2) revert cost-optimization change (adapter replica reduction) until we have autoscaling safety checks, 3) add synthetic scrape alert for adapter queue > 200ms. Assign owners?
jamal: I can take the post-mortem writeup. Sophie owns the config revert PR. Carlos owns node pool/playbook for pull-rate mitigations.
pagerduty: reminder: handoff in 10m. If any of you are leaving, ping the next oncall in the channel and add the checklist.
maya: thanks everyone. I’ll stay on until we hit steady state (queue<50 for 15m). Next update in 5m or on significant change. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Incident triage updated: mitigations applied, severity: P1 -> P2 (monitoring).
